CHARACTER DEFLATIONS AND A GENERALIZATION
OF THE MURNAGHAN–NAKAYAMA RULE
ANTON EVSEEV, ROWENA PAGET AND MARK WILDON
Abstract. Given natural numbers m and n, we deﬁne a deﬂation map
from the characters of the symmetric group Smn to the characters of Sn.
This map is obtained by ﬁrst restricting a character of Smn to the wreath
product Sm ≀Sn, and then taking the sum of the irreducible constituents
of the restricted character on which the base group Sm × · · · × Sm acts
trivially. We prove a combinatorial formula which gives the values of
the images of the irreducible characters of Smn under this

blocks.title: Character deflations
blocks.content: We now introduce the ideas needed to state Theorem [\[thm:cd\]](#thm:cd){reference-type="ref" reference="thm:cd"}. By a construction originally due to Frobenius, the irreducible characters of the symmetric group $S_r$ are canonically labelled by the partitions of $r$. As is usual, we write $\chi^\lambda$ for the irreducible character labelled by the partition $\lambda$, and $\chi^{\lambda / \mu}$ for the character labelled by the skew-partition $\lambda / \mu$. blocks.title: Some special cases
blocks.content:
It is clear than if $m=1$ then $\mathop{\mathrm{Def\hskip-0.3pt res}}_{S_n} \chi=
\chi$ for any character $\chi$ of $S_n$, and so the special case $m=1$ of Theorem [\[thm:cd\]](#thm:cd){reference-type="ref" reference="thm:cd"} asserts that $\chi^{\lambda / \mu} (g) = a_{\lambda/ \mu , \gamma}$ for any skew-partition $\lambda / \mu$ of $n$ and any element $g \in S_n$ of cycle type $\gamma$. Equivalently, $$\chi^{\lambda / \mu} (g) = \sum_{T} \mathrm{sgn}(T)$$ where the sum is over all border-strip tableaux of shape $\lambda / \mu$ and type $\gamma$. blocks.title: Outline of the paper
blocks.content:
The remainder of the paper proceeds as follows. Throughout, we shall adopt the convention that if $\alpha$ is a partition of $r \in \mathbf{N}$, then $g_\alpha \in S_r$ is an element of cycle type $\alpha$, and $z_\alpha$ is the size of the centralizer of $g_\alpha$ in $S_r$. (The choice of $g_\alpha$ within the conjugacy class is irrelevant.) If $\alpha = (\alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_k)$, we write $n\alpha = (n\alpha_1,\ldots,n\alpha_k)$.

blocks.title: Skew characters
blocks.content:
[]{#sec:skew label="sec:skew"}

In this section we state and prove a result on the values of skew characters on elements of the form $g_{n\alpha}$ (Theorem [\[thm:ind\]](#thm:ind){reference-type="ref" reference="thm:ind"}). First, we give the necessary combinatorial definitions. In several arguments we shall refer to James' abacus notation for partitions, as described in [@JK page 78].

We shall define $n$-quotients and $n$-signs for the following class of skew-partitions.

blocks.title: An application to Foulkes' Conjecture
Generalized deflations
blocks.content:
[]{#sec:gendef label="sec:gendef"}

In this section we discuss deflation with respect to an arbitrary irreducible character $\vartheta$ of $S_m$. In the case where $\vartheta$ is labelled by a hook partition, $\vartheta=\chi^{(a,1^b)}$ where $a+b=m$, we give a combinatorial description, generalizing Theorem [\[thm:cd\]](#thm:cd){reference-type="ref" reference="thm:cd"}.
